Executive Assistant (Project/Accounts): 01
Essential Qualifications:
First class in Bachelor of Commerce / Master of Commerce with at least 60% marks in
the qualify degree with minimum of two years of experience. The candidate shall have
sufficient knowledge of GEM portal, report preparation, computer office applications,
M.S Word, Excel, Power-point or equivalent.
Emoluments per month: Rs. 25,000/- (Fixed)
University Institute of Engineering and Technology
Panjab University, Sector-25, Chandigarh 160014
Advertisement
Applications are invited along with bio-data and attested copies of the certificates of
qualification, and experience, for position of Executive Assistant (Project/Accounts) at
University Institute of Engineering and Technology (UIET), Panjab University, Chandigarh
under the project entitled ‘Multi-Modal Framework for Monitoring Active Fire
Locations (AFL) & Precision in Allied Agricultural Activities using Communication
Technologies’ sanctioned by Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology of
Government of India.
The position of Executive Assistant (Project/Accounts) is for a period of 01 year OR
coterminous with project and depending upon the satisfactory performance of the candidate.
Applications with complete Curriculum Vitae containing Qualifications, Experience,
Mailing Address, Email-ID, and Phone Number by scanned self-attested copies of
all relevant documents should be uploaded on Google form
https://forms.gle/Sz16hFUfi8bKoPaZ7 by 23rd March 2023.
The advertisement is published at Panjab University’s website.
The incumbent is expected to work on Saturdays/Sundays and maybe on holidays also for
any project exigency.
The date and venue of the interview will be conveyed to the eligible candidates through email
or phone. No separate call letters will be issued for the interview. No TA/DA will be paid to
the candidates for attending the interview.
Dr. Harish Kumar
Principal Investigator and Professor, CSE
UIET, Panjab University, Chandigarh
